question: Is the spec's collision-free id-namespace design (exp-hist-mortgage-{year}-{NNNN}), the row-125/K-column edge-case handling, and the 14 acceptance criteria (12 offline, 2 interactive) sound and ready to move to build?

artifacts.summary: Spec resolves all three ideation open questions with live evidence: mortgage rows get a distinct exp-hist-mortgage-{year}-{NNNN} id namespace (a shared/combined counter with 061's 1,670 live rows would either duplicate or silently swallow them); attribution and undo scope confirmed unchanged/scoped. Two new defects found and specced around: row-125 (2024-11-15) has a populated date with J/K both blank and currently aborts the run; the House-tab read must widen to D5:K255 for the 2023-03-15 K-column prepayment while still excluding PII columns A-C. 14 ACs (AC-1-12 offline, AC-13/14 interactive), risk evidence, +320 LOC/5-file estimate at +-50% tolerance, and a test plan reusing 062's seeded-decoy technique for the collision ACs.
